_comment: The ONE place for e2e hosts, slugs and backend URLs. scripts/e2e-env.py resolves it with the run's choices (E2E_<SLOT>, E2E_LINK_TYPES, E2E_EXPECT_*) for scripts/e2e-maestro.sh and .github/workflows/e2e.yml. Nothing else may hardcode a host, slug or backend URL. 'host' in links names the environment field the slug is served on. 'link_types': one dedicated link per link type and environment (type -> environment -> {host, slug}; deep link /products/aj1, customData voucher/discountPercent/linkType/source); a type with no entry for the run's environment is skipped with a notice. E2E_LINK_TYPES picks them (all, none, or a comma list). 'link_type_expect': what the link-type allow runs must show. 'rewarded_link_types': the link types whose links carry a per_install reward: an allow install must earn it and a deny install must earn nothing; the other types must have no reward. 'reward_links': the event-reward links (reward model -> environment -> {host, slug, link_type}), run by the deferred_event_* / deferred_revshare_* flows; an environment without one skips those rows with a notice. 'reward_events': what those flows send after the counted install. 'backend_checks': which optional backend checks the environment supports; a false check is recorded as skipped, never pass or fail.
